rationale: Roberts is likely to keep assignment and write a narrow Apprendi/Alleyne opinion holding that ACCA’s “different occasions” finding is a punishment-authorizing fact for the jury (or admission), while preserving Almendarez-Torres for the bare fact of conviction. Gorsuch has elevated odds of a concurrence pressing Sixth Amendment principles and skepticism of Almendarez-Torres, while Thomas and/or Alito likely dissent emphasizing historical practice and administrability.
